prompt.content: What was the average annual value of Mikael Samuelsson's three-year deal with the Vancouver Canucks?

output:
The average annual value (AAV) of Mikael Samuelsson's three-year deal with the Vancouver Canucks was **$1.5 million**.

Samuelsson signed the deal on July 1, 2013, with an AAV of $1.5 million per year. The deal was for three years
